annotations.title: Get Google Search Console index coverage

description: MisarSEO's own index-coverage report for the connected property: which URLs are indexed, excluded, or errored, and why. FREE (no credits) and makes NO call to Google — unlike get_search_console_performance, this reads `gscUrlCoverage`, populated by a nightly scan built on the URL Inspection API's ~2000/day quota, so coverage fills in over days rather than in one pass. `summary` is the headline count per coverageState. `rows` is one page (default 200, max 1000) of the URLs themselves, newest-inspected first — filter to one state with `coverageState`. An empty summary/rows with ok: true means the nightly scan has not populated this property yet, not that every page is fine.

coverageState.description: Filter to one state, e.g. "Submitted and indexed". Free text, matching Google's own strings verbatim.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_search_console_coverage
